_notes: The masonry bands are brick rather than the concrete default so that the roster carries a
worked example of each masonry material. Both are MASONRY and both come apart into blocks;
brick is lighter and much weaker to blast (see assets/materials/materials.json).
This model rather than city_block_tall because this one's geometry actually fractures. The
tall block leans -- 1 to 3 m of plan drift per band, which is in the source art -- and the
surface cut produces unbounded cells on it that TV-013 rejects. That is a property of the
mesh and not of the material.
